## Summary

Describe only the implementation and verified outcome. Do not include user conversations, personal information, private motivations, live resource identifiers or deployment values.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant typecheck, lint, tests and build passed.
- [ ] Mock／synthetic paths still work without paid credentials.
- [ ] Status claims distinguish local, preview, production and unknown.

## Public-safety review

- [ ] No personal data, real application data, audio, filenames, logs or screenshots with live data.
- [ ] No key, token, JWT, signed URL, cookie, secret, private hostname or Cloudflare resource identifier.
- [ ] No account-specific architecture, production database schema, dump or operational topology.
- [ ] Examples use placeholders, `example.test` or synthetic fixtures only.
- [ ] Private deployment files remain ignored and untracked.
- [ ] I reviewed [`docs/PUBLICATION_SAFETY.md`](../docs/PUBLICATION_SAFETY.md).
